newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Chronology of major earthquakes in Latin America.
newsitem.headline: Chronology of major earthquakes in Latin America.

text.p: A powerful earthquake measuring 6.9 on the Richter scale struck Venezuela's Caribbean coast on Wednesday killing at least 59 people.

Venezuela has been hit by worse tremors over the years, including an 1812 quake that killed more than 40,000 people -- 5 percent of the nation's population. Two large geological fault lines run across the north of the country.
This is a chronology of major earthquakes in Venezuela and Latin America in terms of fatalities this century:
1900 - Massive earthquake, registering 8.4 on the Richter scale, with its epicentre 74 miles (120 km) north of Caracas in the Caribbean, hits coastal Venezuela. Number of victims unknown.
1906 - The Santiago, Chile, area is struck by an 8.6 quake, killing 20,000.
1929 - Cumana hit by tidal wave and powerful quake. Number of victims unknown.
1939 - Chile suffers a magnitude 8.3 earthquake that kills 28,000.
1949 - At least 6,000 are killed in Ecuador whan a 6.8 tremor hits.
1950 - Around 20 die and 80 injured after eastern Venezuela is hit by earthquake.
1960 - Chile is devastated when 4,000 die in a quake registering 9.5 on the Richter scale.
1967 - Three hundred die and 2,000 injured in Caracas and surrounding areas after quake hits central Venezuela.
1970 - A magnitude 7.8 earthquake causes a rock slide and flooding in Peru, killing 66,000 people.
1972 - A 6.2 quake in Managua, Nicaragua, kills 5,000.
1974 - Five killed and 20 injured in eastern Venezuela earthquake.
1975 - Jose Felix dam on river Dos Cerritos cracks open after two quakes follow each other in quick succession in western Venezuela.
1976 - A quake hits Guatemala killing 22,000.
1985 - An earthquake hits Mexico causing some 15,000 deaths.
1986 - About 1,000 die in El Salvador after an earthquake measuring 5,5 strikes.
1987 - Colombia and Ecuador are rocked by a quake registering 7.0. 1,000 people are killed.
1997 - Jan. 11 - The Mexican state of Michoacan suffered a 6.9 quake that left one person dead and caused extensive damage.
1997 - Jan. 23 - Bolivia is hit by an earthquake measuring 7.1 on the Richter scale. No reports of deaths.
1997 - The Mexican states of Jalisco and Guerrero are struck in May by quakes measuring 6.7 and 5.9 respectively.
